core_claims.name: Ref / Term / indexRef
core_claims.scope: Intrinsically typed syntax for the complete functions/naturals/case/fix language. Ref gamma a stores a Fin position whose lookup type is a; contexts and type indices are erased, positions and term constructors retained.

core_claims.name: renameTerm / extendRen
core_claims.scope: Arbitrary type-respecting variable maps between context vectors extend under binders and structurally rename every intrinsic term without changing its result type.

core_claims.name: substTerm / extendSub / instantiateTerm
core_claims.scope: General type-preserving simultaneous and single substitution on intrinsic terms; replacements weaken beneath lambda, natural-case, and fixpoint binders.

core_claims.name: Step / progress / valueNormal
core_claims.scope: Intrinsic reduction preserves indexed context/type by construction; every closed term is a value or has a certified next step; any intrinsic value in any context has no outgoing step.

core_claims.name: run / runNatural
core_claims.scope: Total fuelled intrinsic evaluator with finite reduction evidence and a value certificate or exhaustion; no normalization assumption.

core_claims.name: elaborate / forget / forgetElaborate
core_claims.scope: Every external HasType derivation yields a same-context/same-type intrinsic term. For every derivation p of raw t, forgetting elaborate p equals t by structural proof.

core_claims.name: add / multiplication / churchTwo / additionComputed / multiplicationComputed
core_claims.scope: Typed recursive arithmetic and Church two; actual evaluator calculations certify 2+2=4 and 3*2=6.

core_claims.name: captureAvoidance / identityStep
core_claims.scope: Concrete substitution-under-lambda calculation preserving an outer reference and a typed one-step identity application.

exercises.scope: Open substitution under a lambda shifts the replacement to avoid capture.
A certified CBV beta step for intrinsic identity on two.
General normality of values at arbitrary context and type.

deviations: Contexts are Vect values shared with the external calculus; typed references use At : Fin n -> Ref gamma (index i gamma), with vz/vs helpers rather than a second inductive position representation.
The earlier Lambda chapter already uses scoped raw de Bruijn indices; this chapter introduces intrinsic typing and proves an explicit erasure/elaboration correspondence.
Runtime progress helpers are public export so the evaluator can normalize in dependent proofs in importing modules.
Fuel reports a trace and termination/exhaustion reason; exact upstream gas-index accounting and optional renaming/substitution algebra beyond the presented results are not claimed.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts, or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: to be recorded by the primary editor
